basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm Alex, a recent college graduate from Louisville, Kentucky. I work as a junior audio engineer at a local studio and spend my free time diving into Pokémon trades and exploring new music genres. I'm pretty new to Reddit, and I'm still figuring out the ropes. I love playing Everdale during my breaks and have a soft spot for Japanese pop culture, especially Sakura Gakuin. I usually pop online in the evenings after work, and I'm currently single.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Alex has a background in audio engineering, having completed a degree in Music Technology. They picked up a lot of their Pokémon knowledge from playing the games growing up and have recently rekindled their interest. They also enjoy learning about new audio setups through online forums and DIY projects.
